body:
Source: release review of v1.11.1..main. Defects in the pi and opencode host plugins (and the claude-code Stop hook's changed-path scan), each a result that was not obtained being reported as a passing one:
(a) plugins/adlc-pi/lib/gate-tool.mjs: pi resolves a child killed by a signal it did not send as {code: 0, killed: false}; execFailureReason accepts it, so adlc_gate renders PASS and records a code-0 adlc-gate-run entry that shutdown.mjs treats as state-resolving. /adlc-accept (lib/commands.mjs) records a P6 acceptance for the same shape when stdout is not JSON.
(b) plugins/adlc-pi/lib/prosecutor.mjs: parseFindings returns [] for a refusal or unparseable lens reply, so an all-refusal prosecution converges to CLEAN.
(c) plugins/adlc-pi/lib/prosecutor.mjs: buildLensPrompt/buildVerifierPrompt splice the diff, the ticket title and the lens-authored finding raw under forgeable static headers ('=== DIFF ==='), so diff text can steer the verdict.
(d) plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/gate-tool.mjs: `res.status ?? (res.error ? 1 : 0)` maps a signal-killed gate ({status: null, signal}) to exit 0.
(e) plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/session-hooks.mjs, lib/watcher.mjs, lib/keyless-bridge.mjs: git/adlc are spawned with spawnSync and no timeout from in-process host event handlers, so a blocked child freezes opencode; the same null-status normalisation lets a killed `gate-manifest verify` report ok and a killed `git checkout` report a restore.
(f) plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/scaffold.mjs: ensureConfig accepts any existing .adlc/config.json, and scaffold-cli prints 'config.json present' with exit 0 for garbage.
(g) plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/adlc-hook.mjs and plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/session-hooks.mjs gitChangedPaths: `git diff --name-only` and `git ls-files` are read without -z, so a non-ASCII path arrives C-quoted and misses the anchored risk-tier globs; the doc comment wrongly says those commands never quote.

CONTEXT FOR THE BUILDER. pi plugin: plugins/adlc-pi (lib/gate-tool.mjs adlc_gate + exec predicates, lib/commands.mjs /adlc-accept, lib/prosecutor.mjs P5 loop). opencode plugin: plugins/adlc-opencode (lib/gate-tool.mjs, lib/session-hooks.mjs, lib/watcher.mjs, lib/keyless-bridge.mjs, lib/scaffold.mjs + scaffold-cli.mjs). Tests: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs`, `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/*.test.mjs`, `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`. Fixtures use tmp() from @adlc/core/test-kit. plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/prosecute-runner.mjs and prosecute-tool.mjs are edited by another open change and are not touched here. Existing tests that pin the old behaviour and must change: plugins/adlc-pi/test/exec-fail-closed.test.mjs (code-0/no-JSON accept), plugins/adlc-pi/test/prosecutor.test.mjs (parseFindings garbage -> []), plugins/adlc-opencode/test/session-hooks.test.mjs (diff stubs without -z).

NORMATIVE BEHAVIOUR.
1. pi: one exported predicate verdictFailureReason(res) in lib/gate-tool.mjs = execFailureReason plus 'exit 0 with no parseable JSON on stdout' (every adlc_gate and accept run passes --json). adlc_gate throws on it before recording evidence; /adlc-accept accepts only a parsed `ok: true`. A non-zero exit stays a gate result.
2. pi: parseFindings returns {findings, parsed}; a findings array, {findings: [...]} or a single finding object is parsed; anything else is parsed:false and the loop records the lens as degraded ('unparseable lens output'), so the verdict is INCONCLUSIVE.
3. pi: the diff, the ticket title and the finding JSON reach lens/verifier prompts only through @adlc/core fence() (per-call nonce), behind a directive that fenced text is data. The diff and finding are never truncated; the title is capped head-first. scripts/test/prompt-fencing.test.mjs GUARDED lists the builder.
4. opencode adlc_gate: a spawnSync result without a numeric status returns exitCode null, title 'did not complete', metadata.error one of spawn-failed (ENOENT/other error), timed-out (ETIMEDOUT), killed (signal), no-exit-code. The spawn uses killSignal SIGKILL.
5. opencode in-process spawns: every git/adlc spawnSync in session-hooks, watcher and keyless-bridge carries a timeout (5000 ms for git/adlc hooks, 120000 ms for --prompt-only) and killSignal SIGKILL; gitChangedPaths shares one 5000 ms budget across its calls with a 1 ms floor. A child without an exit code is status 1, never 0. auditGateManifest: killed/timed-out verifier -> ok:false with a 'did not finish' warning; ENOENT stays a silent skip (advisory by design).
6. opencode scaffold: an existing config.json that is not a JSON object yields warning '.adlc/config.json exists but is not readable JSON: <reason>', is never overwritten, and scaffold-cli prints it on stderr and exits 1.
7. Both gitChangedPaths read `ls-files --others --exclude-standard -z` and `diff --name-only -z <base> --`, split on NUL; the comment is corrected. `status --porcelain` keeps the existing unquote helper.
8. Documentation: plugins/adlc-pi/README.md + apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/pi.mdx, plugins/adlc-opencode/README.md + apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/opencode.mdx (hand-maintained mirrors).

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA.
- AC1 pi adlc_gate and /adlc-accept refuse {code:0, killed:false, stdout:''}. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/signal-killed-exec.test.mjs`
- AC2 pi prosecution is INCONCLUSIVE when lenses refuse, and its prompts fence diff/title/finding with a nonce. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/prosecutor-fail-closed.test.mjs scripts/test/prompt-fencing.test.mjs`
- AC3 opencode adlc_gate never reports an exit code for a killed or timed-out gate. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/gate-tool-signal.test.mjs`
- AC4 opencode spawns are bounded and a blocked git/adlc returns within 10 s. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/spawn-bounds.test.mjs`
- AC5 opencode /adlc-init reports a malformed config.json and exits 1. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/scaffold-config-probe.test.mjs`
- AC6 non-ASCII risk-tier paths are matched by their real names. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/review-nonascii-paths.test.mjs plugins/adlc-opencode/test/session-hooks-nonascii.test.mjs`
- AC7 Existing suites green. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-pi/test/*.test.mjs && node --test plugins/adlc-opencode/test/*.test.mjs && node --test plugins/adlc-claude-code/hooks/test/*.test.mjs`
- AC8 Docs updated. verify: `grep -c "did not complete" plugins/adlc-opencode/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/opencode.mdx` and `grep -c "JSON" plugins/adlc-pi/README.md apps/docs/content/docs/integrations/pi.mdx` (each >= 1)
- AC9 Mutation gate green. verify: `node scripts/mutation-gate.mjs origin/main --max 12` exits 0

OUT OF SCOPE: fencing and unparseable-lens handling in plugins/adlc-opencode/lib/prosecute-runner.mjs (edited by another open change); extending the prompt-fencing sweep's mechanical detection to plugins/**; the same unbounded-spawn shape in the codex/copilot/cursor hooks, which sit behind hooks.json timeouts; switching `git status --porcelain` to -z.
title: plugins (pi, opencode): fail closed on killed gates and unparseable lenses, fence prosecutor prompts, bound opencode spawns
